definitions.full: H4175. mowreh I. מוֺרֶה noun masculine Psa 84:7 (early) rain (compare יוֺרֶה ); — Joel 2:23 (|| מַלְקוֺשׁ גֶּשֶׁם, ) 2:23 (strike out We), Psa 84:7 . II. מוֺרֶה noun masculine Isa 30:20 teacher ; — absolute in מוֺרֶה אֵלוֺן Gen 12:6 (J) = מֹרֶה אֵלוֺנֵי Deut 11:30 ( אֵלוֺן ᵐ5 ⅏ ), the teacher's terebinth (see אֵלוֺן ) near Shechem; compare הַמּוֺרֶה גִּבְעַת Judg 7:1 teacher's hill near the plain of Jezreel, probably Little Hermon, Nebî Daµî Bd Pal 244 ; the terebinth being a holy tree from which divine teaching was given, and the hill of the teacher the seat of a holy place whence divine teaching was given; see also (of God) Job 36:22 ; here belong probably likewise מוֺרָ֑י Prov 5:13 , and מוֺרֶיךָ Isa 30:20 (twice in verse).
